title: New constraints on Lagrangian embeddings and the shape invariant
summary: For a large class of toric domains in $\mathbb{R}^4$ we determine which product Lagrangian tori can be mapped into the domain by a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism. In other words, we compute the Hamiltonian shape invariant of these toric domains, as defined by Hind and Zhang. The argument relies on new intersection results for product Lagrangian tori in symplectic polydisks.
